race.comment: TOO DARN FINESSE (8) was well in the betting at Grafton last time out and didn't let backers down with a solid victory over this distance range. Winning jockey Osmond stays on top and should be fighting out the finish again. BLUE ALLURE (3) boasts a win over this course and distance, strips fitter third-up and gets some weight off with the 1.5kg claim. Plenty to like about her prospects. LADY WINDERMERE (10) resumes here but has won when fresh before and gets Wiggins on board from a favourable draw. Keep very safe. SPIES ON (7) will be ready to peak now third run back and may trouble the judge with any luck in running. KELANOA (13) best of the rest.
